boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, officially documented study settings in Hesburgh Library, spanning quiet reading rooms, collaborative areas, and computer-equipped workspaces.

cards.title: Lower Level Study Seats
cards.subtitle: Hesburgh Library · Lower Level
cards.notes: Set up at a study table or booth for individual work, then use a lounge chair when you need a quieter reading posture.
cards.short_summary: Quiet lower-level seating with tables, booths, and lounge chairs.
cards.evidence_claim: Hesburgh Libraries describes this area as study tables and booths for individual work plus lounge chairs for quiet reading, with little-to-no noise.
cards.access_notes: Located in Hesburgh Library; confirm building hours before visiting.

cards.title: 1st Floor Research Commons
cards.subtitle: Hesburgh Library · Northeast corner
cards.notes: Choose a table for solo work or meet at the shared seating; this space sits past the staircase near the North Entrance.
cards.short_summary: Window-lined first-floor commons for individual or collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: The official study-spaces page places Research Commons in the northeast corner and lists study tables, lounge chairs, large windows, natural light, and individual or collaborative work.
cards.access_notes: Located in Hesburgh Library; confirm building hours before visiting.

cards.title: 1st Floor Collaboration Hub
cards.subtitle: Hesburgh Library · Northwest corner
cards.notes: Bring a partner or spread out at a large or small table; mobile monitors and whiteboards support work that needs a shared surface.
cards.short_summary: Flexible, daylight-filled collaboration space near the North Entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Hesburgh Libraries lists tables, study nooks, group rooms, videoconference rooms, lounge chairs, mobile monitors, and whiteboards in the 1st Floor Collaboration Hub.
cards.access_notes: Located in Hesburgh Library; confirm building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Mahaffey Scholars Lounge
cards.subtitle: Hesburgh Library · First-floor concourse
cards.notes: Use a small table for individual work, a larger table for a project meeting, or the couches for a casual reading session.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor lounge with tables, couches, and conversational seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The official page says Mahaffey Scholars Lounge, across from Au Bon Pain, has large collaborative tables, small individual tables, couches, and lounge chairs.
cards.access_notes: Located in Hesburgh Library; confirm building hours before visiting.

cards.title: 1st Floor Holtz Grand Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Hesburgh Library · West side
cards.notes: Take a table or comfortable seat by the window wall for a quiet individual session, with views toward the Main Building and Basilica.
cards.short_summary: Quiet first-floor reading room with natural light and campus views.
cards.evidence_claim: Hesburgh Libraries identifies the first-floor Holtz Grand Reading Room as a quiet study space with tables, comfortable seating, natural light, and views of the Main Building and Basilica.
cards.access_notes: Located in Hesburgh Library; confirm building hours before visiting.

cards.title: 2nd Floor Carey Courtyard View
cards.subtitle: Hesburgh Library · South end of second floor
cards.notes: Settle into a lounge chair or use a high-top table between the elevators and grand staircase for individual or small-group work.
cards.short_summary: High-top tables and lounge chairs overlooking Stadium and Library Lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: The official page locates Carey Courtyard View between the elevators and grand staircase and lists lounge chairs, high-top tables, and views of Notre Dame Stadium and Library Lawn.
cards.access_notes: Located in Hesburgh Library; confirm building hours before visiting.

cards.title: 2nd Floor Technology Commons
cards.subtitle: Hesburgh Library · East side of second floor
cards.notes: Use the computer stations or a screen-sharing pod when your work needs technology, then move to a table for individual or group tasks.
cards.short_summary: Second-floor tech workspace with computers, pods, studios, and study tables.
cards.evidence_claim: Hesburgh Libraries lists reservable Mac and PC stations, screen-sharing pods, multimedia studios, group rooms, tables, and individual workstations in Technology Commons.
cards.access_notes: Located in Hesburgh Library; some computer stations are reservable.

cards.title: 2nd Floor North Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Hesburgh Library · North end of second floor
cards.notes: Choose a table along the window wall for a quiet individual session; the room is designed around rows of study tables and daylight.
cards.short_summary: Quiet, window-lined reading room for individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: The official study-spaces page describes the North Reading Room as rows of study tables along a wall of windows, and labels it quiet, individual-study space.
cards.access_notes: Located in Hesburgh Library; confirm building hours before visiting.

cards.title: 2nd Floor Mac Lab
cards.subtitle: Hesburgh Library · Southwest end of Tech Commons
cards.notes: Use a large-screen Mac for projects requiring Adobe Creative Cloud or the listed sound and video-production applications.
cards.short_summary: Computer lab with 28 large-screen Macs and creative-production software.
cards.evidence_claim: Hesburgh Libraries states that the Mac Lab has 28 large-screen Mac computers with Adobe Creative Cloud Suite and additional Pro Apps for sound and video production.
cards.access_notes: Located in Hesburgh Library’s Technology Commons; confirm building hours before visiting.

cards.title: 10th Floor Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Hesburgh Library · Tenth floor
cards.notes: Head past the elevators and study tables for lighted seating among the History Collection when you need an uninterrupted work block.
cards.short_summary: Quiet tower reading room with lighted tables and History Collection books.
cards.evidence_claim: The official page says the 10th Floor Reading Room has lighted study tables surrounded by books from the History Collection and identifies it as quiet individual-study space.
cards.access_notes: Located in Hesburgh Library; confirm building hours before visiting.
